author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0034053 symbiont-mediated perturbation of host defense-related programmed cell death and its child GO:0034054  symbiont-mediated suppression of host defense-related programmed cell death, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29278

Replace by  
 GO:0052040  symbiont-mediated perturbation of host programmed cell death
and GO:0052041  symbiont-mediated suppression of host programmed cell death, respectively. 

Consider also the more specific terms: 
 GO:0052040 symbiont-mediated perturbation of host apoptosis
+ child symbiont-mediated suppression of host apoptosis

19 manual annotations: 
- 18 UniProt (automatically replaced) 
- 1 Reactome 


1 KW
1 UniRule

Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18_0sAqvDc6XBXu_ifb4UaAgx8ORTutW6fv6LSZt3Ris/edit?gid=0#gid=0
title: Review annotations to GO:0034053 symbiont-mediated perturbation of host defense-related programmed cell death and its child GO:0034054  symbiont-mediated suppression of host defense-related programmed cell death
